title: K0 closes aggregate, dereference, lifetime, and invariant syntax
decision: Use explicit init construction, explicit dereference, labelled public reference relations, and a total contract-expression subgrammar. These close requirements already imposed by K0 without adding allocation, inference, or runtime contract behavior.
dissent: The init keyword is more verbose than conventional record literals.
A separate contract grammar duplicates a subset of the value-expression grammar.

compatibility.source: Draft aggregate and returned-reference syntax changes.
compatibility.semantic: No new observable behavior; previously unrepresentable constitutional requirements become representable.
compatibility.proof: Adds aggregate and dereference cases and explicit lifetime relation IDs.
compatibility.artifact: ASR, Core, and spec lock hashes change.
compatibility.tooling: Parsers and canonical syntax consumers must recognize the new nodes.
